body:
Complete the Phase-2 action surface of the herdr plugin (plan §5.3) with two one-shot palette actions and the recommended-keybinding docs. The action infra already exists from t-herdr-3 (merged): bin/action.mjs dispatches on HERDR_PLUGIN_ACTION_ID; lib/actions.mjs planAction(actionId, target, active, opts) is the pure planner returning a plan of kind 'refuse' | 'gate' | 'spawn-pane'; herdr-plugin.toml declares [[actions]]. This ticket extends that with two more actions following the SAME patterns and security discipline, and documents keybindings.

WHAT TO BUILD

1. `ticket-complete` action. New [[actions]] entry (id="ticket-complete", contexts=["pane"], command=["node","bin/action.mjs"], clear title). planAction handles "ticket-complete": if the pane context does not resolve to a repo (target.ok is false) OR there is no active ticket (active is not state 'active'), return a 'refuse' plan (clear notification, nothing spawned). Otherwise return a 'spawn-pane' plan whose spawned command is the FIXED argv ["adlc","ticket","complete",<activeId>] run in the repo (a DRY-RUN preview — no --write; the human drives the actual write in the spawned pane), echoing the resolved repo + active ticket id first, with requiresBin "adlc".

2. `adlc-init` action. New [[actions]] entry (id="adlc-init", contexts=["pane"]). planAction handles "adlc-init": resolve the repo from the pane context — a repo WITHOUT .adlc/ is valid here (this action bootstraps it), so it must not require an active ticket. If no repo resolves, 'refuse' (notification). Otherwise 'spawn-pane' running the FIXED argv ["adlc","init"] in the repo, echoing the repo first, requiresBin "adlc".

3. Keybinding docs. Add a 'Keybindings' section to plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md documenting the recommended herdr keybindings for the board pane and all five actions (ticket-show, gate, prosecute, ticket-complete, adlc-init), naming each action id.

SECURITY (plan §6): actions run UNSANDBOXED. Every spawned command is a fixed argv of a binary resolved on the TRUSTED PATH (resolveOnPath) — never a repo-local path and never anything derived from the untrusted pane context. Context-derived strings that reach a notification are sanitized. Every failure path ends in a clear notification with nothing spawned.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each has a concrete verification method)

AC1 ticket-complete refuses with no repo: planAction('ticket-complete', {ok:false}, null, opts) returns kind 'refuse'. VERIFY: unit test in plugins/adlc-herdr/test/actions-phase2.test.mjs.
AC2 ticket-complete refuses with no active ticket: planAction('ticket-complete', {ok:true,repoRoot}, {state:'absent'}, opts) returns kind 'refuse'. VERIFY: unit test.
AC3 ticket-complete spawns the fixed dry-run argv for the active ticket: planAction('ticket-complete', {ok:true,repoRoot}, {state:'active',id:'t-x'}, opts) returns kind 'spawn-pane' whose spawned argv is exactly ['adlc','ticket','complete','t-x'] (no --write), requiresBin 'adlc', repo+ticket echoed. VERIFY: unit test asserting the argv array.
AC4 adlc-init refuses with no repo: planAction('adlc-init', {ok:false}, null, opts) returns kind 'refuse'. VERIFY: unit test.
AC5 adlc-init spawns the fixed init argv in the repo (no active ticket required): planAction('adlc-init', {ok:true,repoRoot}, {state:'absent'}, opts) returns kind 'spawn-pane' whose spawned argv is exactly ['adlc','init'], requiresBin 'adlc', repo echoed. VERIFY: unit test.
AC6 manifest declares both actions: herdr-plugin.toml has [[actions]] entries for ticket-complete and adlc-init, each contexts=["pane"], command=["node","bin/action.mjs"]. VERIFY: manifest-shape test asserting both ids present.
AC7 keybinding docs name every action: plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md has a Keybindings section, and it mentions EVERY action id declared in herdr-plugin.toml (docs cannot silently drift from the action set). VERIFY: a docs-sync test that parses the manifest action ids and asserts each appears in the README.
AC8 no hollow tests: adlc hollow-test on the changed lib/actions.mjs finds all mutants killed. VERIFY: hollow-test exit 0 (preflight mutation-gate).

RAILS: plugins/adlc-herdr/test/actions-phase2.test.mjs is frozen once authored — the executable contract for the new action planning + manifest + docs-sync.
title: herdr plugin: ticket-complete + adlc-init palette actions and keybinding docs
